summary: Knowledge store write contract (ai-sdlc-enterprise RFC-0002 items 1-5, 8): replace sync put/update with async named write/create (shape B)?

options.description: Full shape B + token: replace put/update with async write/create, closed kind set, status, log events, optional token with retry (breaks 0.45.0 interface)
Additive: optional async write/create beside put/update
Shape B without the token until a real conflict is observed

body: Enterprise operator ruled OQ-A shape B (provisional on their RFC-0002 signers). A remote server must authorize and audit by named operation; update(id, editFn) hides the operation. Conditions: supersede in one call (old id + new fields); closed documented kind set; promote carries target authority + proof; result status includes queued-as-proposal; promote/supersede/confirm/excise never deferred offline (write may reject); server principal from token, passed principal for local log only. Optional opaque concurrency token: reads and results return it, write takes it as expected value, files backend may ignore, wrappers re-read/re-run/retry on conflict. Store logs every write/create incl. no-field-change kinds; write and create return status.
